fusions.name: Haft Vault
fusions.desc: You plant the haft and vault up to 7 tiles to the target, landing blade-first for 15 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Winnowing Toss
fusions.desc: Tosses a spadeful of chaff to the wind in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 wind damage with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Robin at the Spade
fusions.desc: Turns a patch of soil, and a robin comes to it for 10 seconds, pecking an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Run-Up
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
